question: Why are small companies less likely to recommend us?
title: Small companies [[struggle with onboarding]] and question the price
answer: Companies of 1-10 people score NPS [[-49 against +26]] for 250+. Two things explain most of the gap: onboarding and value for money. {{Reliability}} is rated about the same by both.

reasons.label: Reason 1 · Price
reasons.text: 18% of small companies say we are good value, against 60% of large ones.

reasons.label: Reason 2 · Onboarding
reasons.text: 20% of small companies say onboarding was clear, against 56%.

not_cause: reliability, documentation and support are rated about the same by both groups.

chapters.title: Small companies trail [[on price and onboarding]], not on the product
chapters.so_what: The product works as well for small companies; the gap is in getting started and in price.

chapters.title: Small companies describe setup without help

actions.text: Offer guided setup to every new company under 10 people.
Test a smaller plan priced for 2-5 seats.

caveats.text: Both groups have more than 60 responses, and the gaps hold after adjusting for the number of comparisons.
The 250+ group has 62 people, so its score could move by about 15 points in a repeat survey.
